_comment: Copy to templates/<campaign>.json. theme_rules map a recipient's job title to one message theme (first regex match wins, order most-specific first). openers/signoffs carry each sender's voice; closers rotate so a batch never reads as one blast. The renderer refuses em/en dashes in any rendered body. followups: each entry is one touch; after_days counts from the LAST touch; bodies are complete plain-text messages ({first} is the only substitution) - no HTML, no links, deliberately.
subject: Coffee in <your city>

bodies.alice:
Hi {first},

<short nudge in Alice's voice, adds one new thing, no links>

Alice
bodies.bob:
Hi {first},

<short nudge in Bob's voice, adds one new thing, no links>

Bob

bodies.alice:

<last touch in Alice's voice, gives an easy out, no links>
